declarations.name: Applications.Selection.FixedRank.minimumLoop_spec
declarations.source_header:
theorem minimumLoop_spec (best : α) (xs : List α) :
    minimumLoop best xs ∈ best :: xs ∧

theorem select0_some_iff_min (xs : List α) (a : α) :

theorem select0_some_iff_ranked (xs : List α) (a : α) :

theorem boundedInsert_prefix (m : Nat) (x : α) (seen : List α) :

theorem selectFixed_value (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :

theorem selectFixed_some_iff_ranked (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (a : α) :

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.FixedRank.selectFixed_some_iff_count_bounds
declarations.source_header:
theorem selectFixed_some_iff_count_bounds (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (a : α) :
    selectFixed k xs = some a ↔
      xs.countP (fun x => decide (x < a)) ≤ k ∧
        xs.countP (fun x => decide (a < x)) < xs.length - k

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.FixedRank.selectFixed_none_iff
declarations.source_header:
theorem selectFixed_none_iff (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    selectFixed k xs = none ↔ xs.length ≤ k

declarations.source_header:
theorem selectFixed_spec (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hk : k < xs.length) :

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.FixedRank.selectFixed_eq_selectWith
declarations.source_header:
theorem selectFixed_eq_selectWith (choose : List α → Option α)
    (hv : PivotValid choose) (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    selectFixed k xs = selectWith choose (k + 1) xs

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.FixedRank.select0_eq_selectFixed

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.FixedRank.boundedInsert_two
declarations.source_header:
theorem boundedInsert_two (x lo hi : α) :
    boundedInsert 2 x [lo, hi] =
      if x ≤ lo then [x, lo] else [lo, min x hi]

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.FixedRank.prefixLoop_two
declarations.source_header:
theorem prefixLoop_two (lo hi : α) (xs : List α) :
    (prefixLoop 2 [lo, hi] xs)[1]? = some (secondLoop lo hi xs)

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.FixedRank.boundedInsert_singleton
declarations.source_header:
theorem boundedInsert_singleton (x y : α) :
    boundedInsert 2 y [x] = [min x y, max x y]

theorem boundedInsertRun_cost (m : Nat) (x : α) (acc : List α) :

declarations.name: Resources.FixedRank.selectFixedRun
declarations.source_header: def selectFixedRun (k : Nat) (xs : List α) : Measured (Option α) Nat

declarations.source_header:
theorem selectFixedRun_cost (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (selectFixedRun k xs).2 =
      (takeSortRun (k + 1) xs).2 + min k (min (k + 1) xs.length) + 2

declarations.name: Resources.FixedRank.selectFixedRun_cost_le
declarations.source_header:
theorem selectFixedRun_cost_le (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :

declarations.name: Resources.FixedRank.selectFixedRun_uniform_bound

theorem selectFixedRun_uniform_bound :

      (selectFixedRun k xs).2 ≤
        C1 * k * xs.length + C2 * xs.length + C3 * k + C4

declarations.name: Examples.FixedRankSelection.measured_rank_and_bound
declarations.source_header:
theorem measured_rank_and_bound {α : Type} [LinearOrder α]
    (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (a : α)
    (h : xs.countP (fun x => decide (x < a)) ≤ k ∧
      xs.countP (fun x => decide (a < x)) < xs.length - k) :
    (selectFixedRun k xs).1 = some a ∧
      (selectFixedRun k xs).2 ≤ 2 * k * xs.length + 6 * xs.length + k + 4
